description: This file defines a Python client for interacting with the GitHub REST API asynchronously. It includes a factory for creating configured HTTP clients, a main GitHubClient class with methods for searching repositories, fetching repository details, and computing analytics based on search queries. The code also incorporates rate limiting, caching, and request handling logic.

classes.name: _HttpClientFactory
classes.description: Factory class that constructs and returns a configured httpx.AsyncClient instance with appropriate headers and timeout settings.

classes.name: GitHubClient
classes.description: Main asynchronous client class for interacting with the GitHub API. Provides methods for repository search, retrieval, and analytics, incorporating rate limiting and caching.

methods.name: _HttpClientFactory.build
methods.description: Creates and configures an httpx.AsyncClient with headers, base URL, and timeout based on settings.

methods.name: GitHubClient.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the GitHubClient with settings, rate limiter, and HTTP client.

methods.name: httpx.Response _request(self, method: str, url: str, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with rate limiting, handles retries on timeouts or errors, and updates rate limiter state based on response headers.

methods.name: PaginatedResponse[RepositorySummary] search_repositories(self, q: SearchQuery)
methods.description: Searches GitHub repositories based on a SearchQuery object. Uses caching and maps response data to a PaginatedResponse.

methods.name: RepositoryDetail get_repository(self, full_name_or_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific repository identified by owner/name or ID, with caching.

methods.name: AnalyticsSummary get_analytics(self, q: SearchQuery)
methods.description: Computes aggregate analytics over repositories returned by a search query, including total stars, forks, and language distribution, with caching.

methods.name: str _build_github_query(self, q: SearchQuery)
methods.description: Converts a SearchQuery object into a GitHub search query string with appropriate qualifiers.
